text:
jamie: alert from obs - sudden uptick in 503s and p95 on /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 since 11:08. Looks like a regression in embed-runtime v2.5.0 under high-concurrency. I built a hotfix that pins the runtime to v2.4.8 which was stable. Requesting expedited push to Dedicated eu pool and a quick release-note + support handoff.
liam: can we squeeze a 2m micro-canary? if risk is high we should at least exercise one node.
noreen: telemetry: error-rate peaked at 2.6% on shard-4, cache-ejects spiking. Patch built from commit ef12b, artifact gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/ef12b-v2.4.8-pin.tar.gz. Staging smoke + quick perf run passed. Ops + product approvals required for expedite.
jamie: @deploybot run preflight and show blockers; also include change-window note (we're in a 2hr low-impact window).
deploybot: Preflight report: smoke-tests PASS; infra-health PASS; migrations NONE; open-release-PRs 0; config-drift none. Canary-tests: RECOMMENDED. Expedited flag present. Requires interactive approvals: ops + product. React with :white_check_mark: within 7m to approve expedited deploy. Deploy command will include safe rollback hook.
tess: product here. Impact > SLO, OK to expedite if ops provides rollback command and we notify support + release notes updated before deploy.
liam: oncall +1 for micro-canary (2m). Rollback steps posted and I will standby:
```
# rollback to previous stable image and flush KV for embed shards
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.5.0
./tools/kvctl flush --cluster=eu-west1 --service=embed-service --confirm
```
Also deploybot cancel <deploy_id> works as kill-switch.
jamie: noted. I'll draft release note: "hotfix(embed): pin embed runtime to v2.4.8 to avoid KV eviction regression causing 503s under load". Will tag in changelog and ping support.
liam: :white_check_mark: (ops)
tess: :white_check_mark: (product) posting signoff for audit.
jamie: Approved. Triggering deploy now. Deploy ID: deploy_1822222222_hotfix_pin. Micro-canary: 1 node for 2m, then staged roll (concurrency=1).
deploybot: Deploy started by jamie. Canary step: updating node-11. Canary health checks PASS. Observing for 2m.
# +2m
liam: canary metrics stable, no new 503s on canary node. green to proceed to staged roll.
deploybot: Staged roll progressing: 2/6 updated; 4/6 updated; 6/6 updated. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. Traffic shifted to v2.4.8-pin over 90s. Monitoring window 12m.
noreen: +6m post-roll: error-rate back to baseline, p95 improved. No customer tickets flagged.
jamie: updating release notes and changelog now and pinging support to annotate any related tickets. Closing thread once docs updated. Thanks all for quick coordination :rocket:
